## base

Base entity providing common fields for domain models.

### BaseEntity

| Field | Type | Required |
|-------|------|----------|
| id | string | true |
| created_at | Date | true |
| updated_at | Date | true |

## shared enums

Canonical enums defined in `src/shared/types/leave.enums.ts` (Phase 1).

### LeaveStatus

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| DRAFT | Leave request is in draft state |
| SUBMITTED | Leave request has been submitted |
| UNDER_REVIEW | Leave request is under manager review |
| APPROVED | Leave request has been approved |
| REJECTED | Leave request has been rejected |
| CANCELLED | Leave request has been cancelled |

### LeaveTypeCode

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| ANNUAL | Annual leave |
| SICK | Sick leave |
| EMERGENCY | Emergency leave |

### PolicyStatus

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| ACTIVE | Policy is currently in effect |
| SUPERSEDED | Policy has been replaced by a newer version |
| REVOKED | Policy has been explicitly revoked |

### BalanceStatus

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| ACTIVE | Balance is active for the current fiscal year |
| EXHAUSTED | Balance has been fully consumed |
| FROZEN | Balance is frozen (e.g. employee on long-term leave) |

## leave

Represents a leave record managed by the `leave` module, including leave requests and related leave-tracking data.

### LeaveRequest

| Field | Type | Required |
|-------|------|----------|
| id | string | true |
| employeeId | string | true |
| leaveTypeId | string | true |
| startDate | Date | true |
| endDate | Date | true |
| reason | string \| undefined | false |
| status | LeaveStatus | true |
| approvedBy | string \| null | false |
| approvedAt | Date \| null | false |
| createdAt | Date | true |
| updatedAt | Date | true |

**Relationships**
- `Employee` — many-to-one

# PLAN.md

## Phase 1: Phase 1: Shared enums and base types

Create src/shared/types/leave.enums.ts with the canonical enums: LeaveStatus (DRAFT, SUBMITTED, UNDER_REVIEW, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED), LeaveTypeCode (ANNUAL, SICK, EMERGENCY), PolicyStatus (ACTIVE, SUPERSEDED, REVOKED), and BalanceStatus (ACTIVE, EXHAUSTED, FROZEN). Create src/shared/types/index.ts to barrel-export all enums. Include Jest unit tests in tests/unit/shared/types/leave.enums.test.ts verifying each enum has the expected members. This phase has no dependencies on prior phases — only on the existing tsconfig.json and jest.config.js at the project root.

## Phase 2: Phase 2: LeaveType model and repository

Create src/modules/leaveType/leaveType.model.ts with the LeaveType interface (id: string, code: LeaveTypeCode, label: string, description: string, requiresDocumentation: boolean, maxConsecutiveDays: number | null, isPaid: boolean, status: LeaveTypeStatus, createdAt: Date, updatedAt: Date). Import LeaveTypeCode from src/shared/types/leave.enums.ts (Phase 1). Create src/modules/leaveType/leaveType.repository.ts with ILeaveTypeRepository interface and LeaveTypeRepository class using the pg Pool from src/shared/db/connection.ts. Methods: findAll, findById, findByCode. Create src/modules/leaveType/index.ts barrel export. Include Jest unit tests in tests/unit/modules/leaveType/leaveType.repository.test.ts mocking the pg pool. This phase depends on src/shared/types/leave.enums.ts from Phase 1 — read it before generating any code that references its types.

## Phase 3: Phase 3: LeavePolicy model and repository

Create src/modules/leavePolicy/leavePolicy.model.ts with the LeavePolicy interface (id: string, leaveTypeId: string, name: string, entitlementDaysPerYear: number, maxCarryForwardDays: number, minNoticeDays: number, maxConsecutiveDays: number | null, requiresApproval: boolean, effectiveFrom: Date, effectiveTo: Date | null, status: PolicyStatus, createdAt: Date, updatedAt: Date). Import PolicyStatus from src/shared/types/leave.enums.ts (Phase 1). Create src/modules/leavePolicy/leavePolicy.repository.ts with ILeavePolicyRepository interface and LeavePolicyRepository class using the pg Pool from src/shared/db/connection.ts. Methods: findAll, findById, findByLeaveTypeId, findActiveByLeaveTypeId. Create src/modules/leavePolicy/index.ts barrel export. Include Jest unit tests in tests/unit/modules/leavePolicy/leavePolicy.repository.test.ts mocking the pg pool. This phase depends on src/shared/types/leave.enums.ts from Phase 1 — read it before generating any code that references PolicyStatus.

## Phase 4: Phase 4: LeaveBalance model and repository

Create src/modules/leaveBalance/leaveBalance.model.ts with the LeaveBalance interface (id: string, employeeId: string, policyId: string, fiscalYear: number, entitledDays: number, usedDays: number, pendingDays: number, carriedForwardDays: number, remainingDays: number, status: BalanceStatus, createdAt: Date, updatedAt: Date). Import BalanceStatus from src/shared/types/leave.enums.ts (Phase 1). Create src/modules/leaveBalance/leaveBalance.repository.ts with ILeaveBalanceRepository interface and LeaveBalanceRepository class using the pg Pool from src/shared/db/connection.ts. Methods: findByEmployeeId, findByEmployeeIdAndPolicyId, findByEmployeeIdAndFiscalYear, upsert, updateUsedDays. Create src/modules/leaveBalance/index.ts barrel export. Include Jest unit tests in tests/unit/modules/leaveBalance/leaveBalance.repository.test.ts mocking the pg pool. This phase depends on src/shared/types/leave.enums.ts from Phase 1 and src/modules/leavePolicy/leavePolicy.model.ts from Phase 3 — read both before generating any code.

## Phase 5: Phase 5: LeaveRequest model and repository

Create src/modules/leaveRequest/leaveRequest.model.ts with the LeaveRequest interface (id: string, employeeId: string, leaveTypeId: string, startDate: Date, endDate: Date, reason: string | undefined, status: LeaveStatus, approvedBy: string | null, approvedAt: Date | null, createdAt: Date, updatedAt: Date) and CreateLeaveRequestDto (employeeId: string, leaveTypeId: string, startDate: Date, endDate: Date, reason?: string) and UpdateLeaveRequestDto (startDate?: Date, endDate?: Date, reason?: string) and LeaveRequestQueryParams (status?: LeaveStatus, leaveTypeId?: string, startDateFrom?: Date, startDateTo?: Date, endDateFrom?: Date, endDateTo?: Date, limit?: number, offset?: number). Import LeaveStatus from src/shared/types/leave.enums.ts (Phase 1). Create src/modules/leaveRequest/leaveRequest.repository.ts with ILeaveRequestRepository interface and LeaveRequestRepository class using the pg Pool from src/shared/db/connection.ts. Methods: findById, findByEmployeeId, findByEmployeeIdWithQuery, create, update, updateStatus. Create src/modules/leaveRequest/index.ts barrel export. Include Jest unit tests in tests/unit/modules/leaveRequest/leaveRequest.repository.test.ts mocking the pg pool. This phase depends on src/shared/types/leave.enums.ts from Phase 1 and src/modules/leaveType/leaveType.model.ts from Phase 2 — read both before generating any code.

## Phase 6: Phase 6: LeaveRequest service

Create src/modules/leaveRequest/leaveRequest.service.interface.ts with ILeaveRequestService interface: create(dto: CreateLeaveRequestDto): Promise<LeaveRequest>, approve(id: string, approverId: string): Promise<LeaveRequest>, reject(id: string, approverId: string): Promise<LeaveRequest>, cancel(id: string, employeeId: string): Promise<LeaveRequest>, findById(id: string): Promise<LeaveRequest | null>, findByEmployeeId(employeeId: string, query?: LeaveRequestQueryParams): Promise<LeaveRequest[]>. Create src/modules/leaveRequest/leaveRequest.service.ts implementing ILeaveRequestService. The create method must: validate the leave type exists via ILeaveTypeRepository, validate an active policy exists via ILeavePolicyRepository, check balance sufficiency via ILeaveBalanceRepository, validate no overlapping requests, then create the request and update pendingDays on the balance. The approve/reject methods must update the request status and adjust balance usedDays/pendingDays. Inject repositories via constructor. Update src/modules/leaveRequest/index.ts to export the new service and interface. Include Jest unit tests in tests/unit/modules/leaveRequest/leaveRequest.service.test.ts with mocked repositories. This phase depends on all model/repository files from Phases 2-5 — read them before generating any code.

## Phase 7: Phase 7: LeaveRequest controller and routes

Create src/modules/leaveRequest/leaveRequest.controller.ts with LeaveRequestController class. It receives ILeaveRequestService via constructor. Methods: create(request, reply), approve(request, reply), reject(request, reply), cancel(request, reply), getById(request, reply), getByEmployeeId(request, reply). Each method extracts params/body from the Fastify request, calls the service, and returns the appropriate HTTP status. Use Zod (already in package.json) for input validation on create/update payloads per GP-003. Create src/modules/leaveRequest/leaveRequest.routes.ts exporting a Fastify plugin that registers routes: POST /leave-requests, GET /leave-requests/:id, GET /leave-requests/employee/:employeeId, PATCH /leave-requests/:id/approve, PATCH /leave-requests/:id/reject, PATCH /leave-requests/:id/cancel. Update src/modules/leaveRequest/index.ts to export the controller and routes. Include Jest unit tests in tests/unit/modules/leaveRequest/leaveRequest.controller.test.ts with a mocked service. This phase depends on src/modules/leaveRequest/leaveRequest.service.interface.ts and src/modules/leaveRequest/leaveRequest.model.ts from Phases 5-6 — read them before generating any code.

## Phase 8: Phase 8: Wire leave routes into the Fastify app

Update src/app.ts to import and register leaveRequestRoutes from src/modules/leaveRequest/leaveRequest.routes.ts. Instantiate the full dependency chain: create pg Pool from src/shared/db/connection.ts, instantiate LeaveTypeRepository, LeavePolicyRepository, LeaveBalanceRepository, LeaveRequestRepository, then LeaveRequestService, then LeaveRequestController, and pass the controller to the routes plugin. Register the routes under a /api prefix. Include an integration test in tests/integration/leaveRequest/leaveRequest.routes.test.ts that starts the Fastify app with listen({ port: 0 }), sends real HTTP requests, and asserts responses. This phase depends on src/modules/leaveRequest/leaveRequest.routes.ts from Phase 7 and all repository/service files from Phases 2-6 — read them before modifying src/app.ts.
